weapons.name: Double Rainbow!
weapons.status: Default primary [Fan-wiki: class page + infobox]. Already in Battle Bears Royale (BBR) Gear Up menus by Oct 2012 [Observed: File:Double_Rainbow.jpg, uploaded 2012-10-24]. Probably part of the BBR launch kit [Inference]. Era changes [Fan-wiki]: BBR 1.4.2 (28 Feb 2013) min damage 50→55; BBG 2.2 (21 Aug 2013) it no longer keeps spinning after the Huggable dies; BBG 2.6 (20 Dec 2013) min 55→25, max 80→40, duration 3→5. The 2026 Steam trailer does not show it [Observed absence].
weapons.official_text: "Attack in all directions for a brief period of time. Use when diving into large groups of hapless victims!" [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Double_Rainbow!
weapons.mechanics: Fire mode: one tap, self-centred, no projectile [Fan-wiki]. The wiki says it "creates two spinning rainbows that rotate around the user and damage anyone within its range, lasting for several seconds"; near the end "the range of the two rainbows will slowly decrease until they completely disappear"; using melee cancels it; Explosions+ raises damage; combined with Flawless Disguise it causes self-injury [Fan-wiki]. Infobox: Explosives 45-90/s, AoE listed, duration 4.0 s, recharge 7 s [Fan-wiki]. This conflicts with the 2.6 notes' duration of 5. The 2012 menu shows stat bars Explosives / AOE / Duration / Cooldown [Observed: File:Double_Rainbow.jpg]. LOOK: the menu card is a 2D comic illustration on a black grid with green floor lines and a neon-green rim. The Huggable floats or tumbles with arms spread, and two broad rainbow arcs (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, violet bands) sweep around it from left and right like spinning blades [Observed: Photo_27-04-13_11_29_40_AM.png]. Icon: the grinning Huggable face with rainbow arcs on both sides [Observed: File:Double_Rainbow.jpg]. The in-game 3D effect was not seen [Unverified]. An official 2011 BBR Sneak Peek frame shows a flat, wide rainbow ribbon lying on grass next to a melee-ing Huggable; I could not tell which ability made it [Observed: https://i.ytimg.com/vi/IucMFqzR_Qw/hq2.jpg; attribution Unverified]. Depiction for shorts: two rainbow ribbons orbit at waist height like rotor blades and shrink to nothing at the end; hit bears tumble away in rainbow sparkles [BBG News invention].

weapons.name: Headlights
weapons.slot: primary (ability; the class's only long-range attack)
weapons.status: Unlock: 32,000 Joules, level 4 [Fan-wiki]. Existed in BBR by 3 Feb 2012: BBR 1.2.1.1 notes say "Fixed bugs including the one caused by the Soaker and Headlights" [Game text via wiki: Updates page]. Era changes [Fan-wiki]: BBR 1.4.2 damage 40→45/s, duration 2.7→4.0 s; BBG 2.1 (15 Jul 2013) range "significantly shortened" and Damage+ no longer applied (per the usage text; the trivia contradicts this on which equipment applies); BBG 2.2 it no longer keeps firing after death; BBG 2.6 damage 45→35, duration 4→5. Not seen in the 2026 trailer.
weapons.official_text: "Remove your head and fire out a cutting death beam of rainbow essence. This is the Huggable's only ranged attack!" [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Headlights . Related SkyVu wording: "Limited Edition Huggable Pink Battle Bear Plushie comes with a unique detachable head that uncovers a secret rainbow beam, the source of the Huggable's power!" [Canon] https://battlebears.com/products/huggable-plushie-with-in-game-bonus
weapons.mechanics: Fire mode: one tap. The Huggable "takes off its head and shoots a rainbow beam", a "long, continuous rainbow beam lasting a few seconds"; the player steers it by aiming; no melee while it fires [Fan-wiki]. Infobox: 60 dmg/s, 5 s duration, 6 s recharge, range 1250 units [Fan-wiki]. Glitch: whatever the skin, it pulls off a Hannible-skin head [Fan-wiki]. The wiki says it was inspired by the BB-1 / BB Zombies / BB Zero headshot death, where the head "would fly off far into the distance, leaving behind a trail of rainbows" [Fan-wiki]. LOOK: the menu card shows the Huggable holding its own detached head low at its left side (the head has an "o" mouth, a tear, a bandage, and a green radio with a blue-tipped antenna). A white sparkle burst sits at the neck stump, and a straight, wide, multi-band rainbow beam (violet, magenta, red-orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue) fires horizontally out of the neck. The card also shows a metal knee brace and a dark wrist cuff with a blue gem [Observed: zoom/headlights_x3.png from Photo_27-04-13_11_29_41_AM.png]. Icon: the Huggable face with a rainbow beam and white burst shooting out to the left [Observed: File:Headlights.jpg]. In-game 3D beam not seen [Unverified]. Depiction for shorts: head tucked under one arm like a helmet while the neck stump sprays a rainbow laser; afterwards it gropes for its head and screws it back on [BBG News invention].

weapons.name: So Fly
weapons.status: Unlock: 60 Gas, level 6 [Fan-wiki]. Originally 25,000 Joules, changed to 60 Gas in BBR 1.4.2 (28 Feb 2013) [Fan-wiki]. In BBR menus by Oct 2012 [Observed: File:So_Fly.jpg]. Era changes [Fan-wiki]: BBG 2.0 added mid-air steering (before that it flew only straight); BBG 2.2 it no longer keeps flying and damaging after death; BBG 2.6 flying speed 500→510, damage 50-70 → 60-80, tired time 5→4. 2026: the official trailer shows a matching flight [Observed; identification is Inference]. BB Heroes (2024): So Fly is Huggy's Ultimate [Canon].
weapons.official_text: "Fly forward with a burst of speed while damaging all in your way. Also very useful for getting around the maps! Aim up fly up!" [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/So_Fly . BBH: "Huggy's Ultimate, So Fly, allows him to soar across large parts of the map, dealing increased damage to enemies for a short period when he lands." [Canon] https://battlebears.com/pages/characters
weapons.mechanics: Fire mode: one tap; the Huggable itself is the projectile. It "will fly forward a short distance in a stream of rainbows, damaging any enemy player in its path", in any direction including up, and is steerable since 2.0. Damage is 60-80 by proximity and contact time; 3 s duration, 9.5 s recharge, 575 u/s; no equipment affects it [Fan-wiki]. It can reach otherwise unreachable map areas (H.I.P. Test Lab, Shortest Parsec Easter eggs) [Fan-wiki]. LOOK (2D menu card): the Huggable flies horizontally, head first, in a Superman pose with arms forward. A wavy multi-band rainbow trail (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, violet) streams from its feet, with a white sparkle burst where the trail meets the body [Observed: Photo_27-04-13_11_29_45_AM.png; File:So_Fly.jpg]. LOOK (2026 official Steam trailer, ~30.25-30.9 s): a pink Huggable rises off the floor with an orange-yellow light column beneath it. It then flies horizontally, belly down and head first, antenna up, across the room toward a sniper bear. At the take-off spot is a large magenta-and-white burst of spiky crystal-like shards with a tall magenta light pillar and faint yellow/green fringes, and it stays there until ~32.4 s. A broad white-and-magenta light wedge streaks across the frame mid-flight [Observed: dl/huggable/trailer_hug/f_008.jpg-f_011.jpg (≈30.4-30.75 s); visuals/trailer/t_0062.jpg (30.5 s); Steam screen_01.jpg]. That this is So Fly is [Inference] (the pose matches; no HUD). The 2026 effect reads mostly magenta and white, not the striped rainbow of the 2012-13 art [Observed]. Depiction for shorts: launch with a pink-white sparkle pop, then a rainbow contrail behind a flying plush [BBG News invention, combining the card and trailer].

weapons.name: Static Shuffle
weapons.status: Unlock: 60 Gas, level 1; originally 180 Gas, then the most expensive weapon [Fan-wiki]. Released in BBR 1.4.3 (15 Apr 2013) [Game text via wiki: release notes]. It is the only Huggable primary affected by Damage+ [Fan-wiki]. No later reworks recorded.
weapons.official_text: "This mid-range attack might just be enought to spark your opponent's demise!" [Game text via wiki, typo as quoted] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Static_Shuffle . BBR 1.4.3 release notes: "Static Shuffle: Huggable's mid-range attack! Charge up and watch electricity fly! Damage and size depend on charge length." [Game text via wiki: store update notes as transcribed on https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Battle_Bears_Royale ; the Updates page truncates it to "charge leng,"]
weapons.mechanics: Fire mode: tap for an uncharged blast, or hold / double-tap to charge for up to 6 s. While charging "the Huggable rubs its head on its body to induce frictional static electricity" with a rising, harsh static sound. On release "a bright blue blast of electricity is shot from where the Huggable's head should have been"; when charged it is "much more violent and shining" and reaches further. Damage 60 uncharged, 75 charged; reload 2.5 s. Afterwards "small electrical particles will remain present in the air for several seconds" and damage enemies who touch them. If the Huggable dies mid-use (not by explosion) the body lands decapitated [Fan-wiki]. LOOK (menu card): the head is lifted high on a long, stretched, stitched neck rising from a frayed collar, with a happy open mouth; white lightning bolts with cyan edges radiate all around; dark wrist cuff with a blue gem [Observed: zoom/static_x3.png]. Concept sketches A/B/C on black (head on a stretched neck, lightning) [Observed: 551341_10152742125825174_1995293618_n.png; the wiki labels it "Concept art"; its official provenance is Unverified, though the Facebook-style filename suggests a SkyVu FB post (Inference)]. HUD icon: cyan-blue Huggable face flanked by white-cyan lightning, with a 'CHARGING' label; faint thin pale lightning threads near the Huggable [Observed, low-res fan video thumbnail https://i.ytimg.com/vi/c6MuK2LKDGk/hqdefault.jpg]. A wiki screenshot shows a headless red Huggable corpse on the Marecraft map [Observed: Static_shuffle_head_decapitation.jpeg]. CONFLICT: the wiki says the blast comes from where the head should be, but the official card shows the head raised on a stretched neck. Depiction for shorts: neck stretches up like a spring, the head buzzes with blue-white arcs, then a cone of lightning discharges and leaves crackling sparks hanging in the air [BBG News invention].

weapons.name: Losing Your Head
weapons.status: Unlock: 100,000 Joules, no level lock [Fan-wiki]. Added in BBG 2.6 (20 Dec 2013) [Fan-wiki: Battle Bears Gold/Versions and 2.6 page]. No later changes recorded.
weapons.official_text: "Just when you thought the huggable could not be any more dangerous, it takes it's head off and tries to kill you... to death. " [Game text via wiki, typo as quoted] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Losing_Your_Head
weapons.mechanics: Fire mode: one tap; self-centred explosion. "The Huggable will shake off its head, which will land at its feet and explode almost instantly in a bright blue blast. The explosion created in large and spherical, and will envelop the Huggable"; damage falls off with distance; no self-damage. Afterwards "the Huggable simply grabs a new head, seemingly out of nowhere, and attaches it to its body". It works in mid-air, and melee before the head lands cancels it [Fan-wiki]. Infobox: Explosives 30-70, AoE listed, recharge 2.5 s; the usage text says a "four second reload" (conflict) [Fan-wiki]. Its explosion is "very similar to those caused by the Phantom Hug, the only difference between the two being the actual colour of the blast" [Fan-wiki]. Glitch: dying right after use leaves no head at all [Fan-wiki]. It has no menu slide; the Gear Up shows the normal stance [Fan-wiki], confirmed: File:LYH.jpg shows the 3D Huggable standing, arms out, with dark wrist cuffs set with glowing red gems [Observed]. The explosion was not seen in any image [Unverified]; the fan demo thumbnails (sShVWYc6MpQ) show no blast. Depiction for shorts: the head pops off, bounces once at its feet and detonates in a blue sphere; a fresh head is slapped on from off-screen [BBG News invention, built on the wiki description].

weapons.name: Tough Love
weapons.status: Default secondary [Fan-wiki]. In BBR menus by Oct 2012 [Observed: File:Tough_Love.jpg]. Era changes [Fan-wiki]: BBR 1.4.2 cooldown 20→15, duration 30→35; BBG 2.6 tired time 7→14, duration 35→10. The infobox now says 20 s duration and 4 s recharge (conflicts).
weapons.official_text: "Conjure within yourself ancient primal magicks and funnel it into a temporary 50% bonus to all melee damage!" [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Tough_Love
weapons.mechanics: No projectile. Activation: "the Huggable will waves its hands for approximately 3 seconds"; using melee interrupts it. After that "the Huggable is trailed by a stream of hearts" and melee damage is +50%; re-using it resets the timer [Fan-wiki]. LOOK: the 2013 infobox card shows a grinning Huggable (red button eye, wide white grin, torn leg) chasing a sweating, alarmed brown bear with a red headband and a bullet bandolier, against a background full of glossy red hearts [Observed: Tough_love.jpg]. The 2012/2013 menu card shows the same chase, with the Huggable running inside a cloud of red hearts [Observed: Photo_27-04-13_11_29_52_AM.png]. Icon: the Huggable face inside a cluster of red hearts [Observed: File:Tough_Love.jpg]. The in-game heart trail was not seen [Unverified]. Depiction for shorts: a frantic hand-wave 'spell', then a trail of red hearts puffs off it as it runs [BBG News invention, following the wiki text].

weapons.name: Mini Me
weapons.status: Unlock: 45,000 Joules, level 8 [Fan-wiki]. In BBR menus by Oct 2012 [Observed: File:Mini_Me.jpg]. BBR 1.4.2 fixed Mini Me map glitches; BBG 2.6 duration 20→7 [Fan-wiki]. Infobox: 8 s duration, 10 s recharge.
weapons.official_text: "Become very tiny and make it that much harder for enemies to hit you!" [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Mini_Me
weapons.mechanics: No projectile or damage. "The player becomes very tiny"; no speed increase; it cannot collect pickups unless it jumps; lock-on is harder; the activation animation is the same as Peek A Boo's, with a laughing sound; on death it may pop back to full size and freeze [Fan-wiki]. LOOK (menu card): a trail of fading, translucent, green-outlined afterimages of the Huggable shrinking from large to small, ending in a small solid pink Huggable, with green sparkle particles [Observed: Photo_27-04-13_11_29_54_AM.png]. Icon: a small Huggable face in front of a larger dark translucent silhouette [Observed: File:Mini_Me.jpg]. The 'Mini Me in use' wiki screenshot is a low third-person view of the Huggable's back near the floor; you can't judge size from it [Observed: 083C005C-....jpg]. Depiction for shorts: a shrinking 'echo' of three ghost outlines snapping down to a toy-sized Huggable in a puff of green sparkles [BBG News invention, following the card].

weapons.name: Peek A Boo
weapons.status: Unlock: 115,000 Joules, level 17 [Fan-wiki]. In BBR menus by Oct 2012 [Observed: File:Peek_A_Boo.png]. Era changes [Fan-wiki]: BBR 1.4.2 cooldown 60→50, duration 20→25, tired 10→8, a 0→10 damage bonus added (the wiki says it does not work), and a team-coloured neon outline/aura added (before 1.4.2 the Huggable showed as "a light greyish shape"); BBR 1.4.3 removed the outline from Cloaking only; BBG 2.6 removed it from Peek A Boo too, made the Huggable less visible (min 0.02→0.01, max 0.2→0.1), cooldown 50→40, duration 25→30, tired 8→3. Current infobox: 4 s duration, 6 s recharge (conflicts).
weapons.official_text: "By pressing small amounts of rainbow out of their bodies, Huggables can match the color of their surroundings and become all but invisible to the untrained eye!" [Game text via wiki; the page labels it "Offical"] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Peek_A_Boo
weapons.mechanics: No projectile. "A short burst of rainbow energy will be emitted above the Huggable and the player will become totally invisible"; taking damage makes it flicker visible; attacking or using a Special ends it; enemy Snipers and Demos cannot lock on [Fan-wiki]. LOOK (menu card): the Huggable is reduced to an empty neon-green outline (antenna, ears, arm) with a black interior, half hidden in white foam clouds and floating white-blue bubbles [Observed: Photo_27-04-13_11_29_57_AM.png; File:Peek_A_Boo.png]. Icon: the Huggable face in a white bubble cloud [Observed]. A pre-1.4.2 gameplay thumbnail (320x180) shows a grey translucent figure with a blue team marker on grass and a large pink-white glowing ring; it is too low-res to say which element is the Huggable [Observed / Unverified: zoom/mqdefaul_x3.png]. CONFLICT: the wiki text says a 'rainbow burst', but the official card shows white bubbles and foam. Depiction for shorts: a soap-bubble 'poof', after which only a faint outline or nothing remains [BBG News invention, following the card].

weapons.name: Super Size Me!
weapons.status: Unlock: 150,000 Joules, level 10 [Fan-wiki]. Added in BBG 2.20 (29 May 2015) [Fan-wiki: Versions list]. Rework: it "used to be the only Huggable secondary that heals while being used, although it no longer heals" (date unknown) [Fan-wiki].
weapons.official_text: "Super Size your huggable! Damage foes with the stomps of your feet while they scream in terror of your size! " [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Super_Size_Me!
weapons.mechanics: No projectile; self-centred AoE. "The Huggable will grow in size and have more Melee hitbox while the player starts to create colored shockwaves similar to those of the Happy Hour and Metal Crush, damaging any opposing player within its AoE"; the Huggable is slowed (Slow Amount 25%) [Fan-wiki]. Infobox: explosive damage 20-40, duration 4 s, recharge 6 s [Fan-wiki]. The wiki page has no image, and the File-namespace search found none [Observed absence]. Look Unverified; the visual researcher should check the Happy Hour and Metal Crush pages for the shockwave look the wiki compares it to. Depiction for shorts: a giant Huggable stomping, each footfall sending a coloured ring shockwave across the floor [BBG News invention, following the wiki text].
image_leads: none on wiki page; compare File: images on https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Happy_Hour and https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Metal_Crush (shockwave reference per wiki)

weapons.name: Phantom Hug
weapons.slot: secondary (saboteur projectile; the only ranged Huggable secondary)
weapons.status: Unlock: 40 Gas, level 1, the first Huggable secondary priced in Gas [Fan-wiki]. Added in BBG 2.2 (21 Aug 2013) [Fan-wiki: Versions list]. Official teaser art went up on the wiki on 1 Aug 2013, before release [Observed: upload timestamp].
weapons.official_text: "The Huggable's ability to love will make time seem like it comes to a halt. When actually it's just your feet and you're about to die." [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Phantom_Hug
weapons.mechanics: Fire mode: a single shot (ammo 1, reload 5 s). "The Huggable fires a cluster of pink energy in the shape of a Huggable, which disperses on impact with a surface". When the phantom hits any surface or player "it will explode in a moderate AoE". Enemies caught cannot move or turn for 2.5 s but can still attack, jump and use Specials. It deals no damage, destroys Proximity Mines, passes through the Iron Curtain, and gives a 5% speed boost [Fan-wiki]. Status icon: the Status Effects page lists Phantom Hug under 'Slowed' (immobile), shown as "a yellow Z ... over the player's head" [Fan-wiki]. That Z appears in a fan Everyplay thumbnail as a big yellow block 'Z' flanked by curved white arrows above a player's head; the cause in that clip is unknown [Observed: https://i.ytimg.com/vi/eRL6OoX--zA/hq1.jpg -> zoom/cr_z.png]. Losing Your Head's blast is "very similar" to this explosion apart from colour [Fan-wiki]. LOOK (official promo art with a 'BATTLE BEARS GOLD' logo and a SkyVu Entertainment watermark): a translucent, glowing pink ghost-Huggable with a yellow-white electric rim light is wrapped over the head and face of a screaming, muscular white bear (red wristbands, red belt with a gold-and-red champion buckle). The real Huggable stands small at lower right, grinning, with blue-gem wrist cuffs [Observed: Phantom_Hug.jpg, Frontpage-news-phantom-hug.png, PH_MenuDisplay.jpg]. A fan gameplay thumbnail shows pink-purple crackling wisps around a Huggable's arms; reading this as the launch is [Inference] [Observed: https://i.ytimg.com/vi/Ac4XjUzc6tY/hq1.jpg]. Depiction for shorts: a see-through pink Huggable ghost flies out, latches onto a bear's face in a hug and bursts in a pink puff; the victim freezes in place with a yellow 'Z' over its head [BBG News invention, built on the official art and the wiki].

weapons.name: Charged Run
weapons.slot: secondary (ability: ground dash; the only Huggable secondary that does direct damage)
weapons.status: Added in BBG 2.6 (20 Dec 2013) at 160 Gas, then the most expensive weapon in BBG [Fan-wiki: 2.6 page + usage text]. The class page and infobox now list 60 Gas (CONFLICT; a price drop is not documented) [Fan-wiki]. No level lock.
weapons.official_text: "And I ran, I ran so far away, I ran all night and day… had to destroy all the Battle Bears?" [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Charged_Run
weapons.mechanics: Fire mode: tap for an instant dash, or hold to charge. It "sends the Huggable running forward on the ground at 600 units per second", dealing 40 damage once to each opponent it passes through. While charging, the Huggable cannot move; a full charge is "indicated by sparkling particles coming out of the Huggable's body" and a Crossbow-like charged sound. The run lasts 1.5 s, or 4 s when fully charged; charge time is given as both 3 s and 2.5 s (conflict); recharge 6 s. Melee cancels it [Fan-wiki]. Its Gear Up stance is identical to Phantom Hug's [Fan-wiki]. File:ChargedRunStance.jpg shows the 3D Huggable with one arm raised and the other bent, wearing dark wrist cuffs with a red light [Observed]. Fan demo thumbnails show an orange-skin Huggable in third person with no visible run FX [Observed: zoom/yt_eRL6OoX--zA.png]. Depiction for shorts: a low sprint with sparkles, bowling bears over like pins [BBG News invention].

weapons.name: Bite Me
weapons.status: Default melee [Fan-wiki]. In BBR menus in 2012 [Observed: File:Bite_me.png, 2012-11-25]. Damage history [Fan-wiki]: BBR 1.4.2 35→40; BBG 2.6 40→35; the page now says 80 after a recent buff (inconsistent). The BBH default Huggy carries a version of it [Fan-wiki].
weapons.official_text: "That's a bit of iron-y." [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Bite_Me
weapons.mechanics: Melee swing with both paws; "this damage is often doubled due to the duplicate melees used in the attack" [Fan-wiki]. The wiki calls it "a beartrap of some sort" that "appears to be covered in Huggable blood" [Fan-wiki]. LOOK (3D Gear Up render): two large black bear-trap jaws, each an open loop of serrated triangular teeth hinged on a round black mount clamped at the paw. The teeth and jaw edges are smeared with iridescent rainbow colours (red, green, blue, purple), which is the rainbow 'blood' [Observed: Photo_27-04-13_11_30_26_AM.png; HuggyBiteMeCR.jpg; Bite_me.png]. Icon: a black crocodile-style jaw with rainbow teeth [Observed]. A pink Huggable with Bite Me appears in the official 2011 BBR Sneak Peek HUD (black jaw icon) [Observed: zoom/sneak_hq2.png]. BBH Huggy: "two automatic clamping bear traps strapped around his hands, that have dried up bits of rainbow colors on the edges of the teeth and base" [Fan-wiki: Huggy page]. Depiction for shorts: twin black traps snap shut on a target with a metallic CLACK and flecks of rainbow [BBG News invention].

weapons.name: Seesaw
weapons.status: Price CONFLICT: the class page says 20 Gas, the weapon page says 40 Gas with a level 3 lock; price history 5,700 Joules → 50 Gas → 25 Gas → 40 Gas [Fan-wiki]. In BBR 2012 menus [Observed: File:Seesaw.png]. Changes [Fan-wiki]: BBR 1.4.2 damage 45→49, special cooldown -15%→-20%; BBG 2.6 damage 49→45, special-cooldown modifier replaced by +10% speed.
weapons.official_text: "The Battle Bear who fashioned the first Huggable with chainsaw hands should not have been faulted for his scientific pursuits, but he was." [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Seesaw
weapons.mechanics: Melee with both paws: 40 per saw, often doubled; "slowest draw time but also the longest duration and largest hitbox" [Fan-wiki]. The wiki says it is covered in Huggable blood and likely based on Riggs' BB-1 Chainsaw [Fan-wiki]. LOOK (3D): an orange boxy chainsaw housing over each paw with black vent stripes, and a long dark-grey guide bar with dark triangular teeth; the bar tip and teeth are smeared with rainbow colours [Observed: Photo_27-04-13_11_30_30_AM.png; HuggySeesawCR.jpg (red Gummable skin); Seesaw.png (Leatherface-style skin, 2012, shows 'SPECIAL SPEED' stat)]. The official BBR 'HUGGABUNDLE' banner shows rainbow drips falling off the bar [Observed: Huggabundle.png]. Icon: an orange body with a rainbow-toothed bar [Observed]. Also seen as the HUD melee icon in a Static Shuffle death screenshot [Observed]. Depiction for shorts: twin orange chainsaws revving, spraying rainbow flecks instead of blood [BBG News invention, following the art].

weapons.name: Whack-Tus

CLASS-LEVEL FINDINGS
1. MAPPING ERROR: weapons_by_class.json["Huggable"] has 25 entries, but only 18 are Huggable weapons. The other 7 (A Salt Rifle, Heavy A Salt Rifle, Soaker, Spreadshot (BBG), Steamshot, B.E.A.R. Club, Krikkit Bat) are Soldier weapons: each page's infobox and category says Soldier. They came in through a Soldier changelog block copy-pasted onto the "Huggable (BBG)" page under "BBR Version 1.0". That block also lists Bearzooka and Oliver skins. Remove them from Huggable. Two other near-misses are not Huggable weapons either: "Huggable Gloves" is a Heavy (Riggs) melee, and "Double Hug" is a Demo (Tillman) melee [Fan-wiki]. The "Huggable (BBG)/Weapons" subpage is an empty stub. Category:Huggable (class) has no extra or removed weapons.
2. Canonical list, 18 weapons [Fan-wiki class page]:
   - Primaries: Double Rainbow! (default), Headlights (32,000 J), So Fly (60 Gas), Static Shuffle (60 Gas), Losing Your Head (100,000 J).
   - Secondaries: Tough Love (default), Mini Me (45,000 J), Peek A Boo (115,000 J), Super Size Me! (150,000 J), Phantom Hug (40 Gas), Charged Run (60 Gas listed; 160 Gas at launch).
   - Melee: Bite Me (default), Seesaw (20 or 40 Gas, conflict), Whack-Tus (50,000 J), Presidentures (30,000 J), Punk Bands (110,000 J), Bearettas (20 Gas), Beaver Feaver (20 Gas).
3. How the class works [Fan-wiki]: primaries and secondaries are abilities, not guns. "Reload" is renamed "Recharge", and the Huggable cannot switch abilities until the recharge finishes, so it leans on melee. Several abilities carry a "Tired time" stat. All seven melees are paired, one per paw, so damage is "often doubled" [Fan-wiki]; all seven Gear Up renders show a weapon on each paw [Observed]. Head-removal moves: Headlights, Static Shuffle, Losing Your Head [Fan-wiki]. SkyVu's plush text ties the detachable head to "a secret rainbow beam, the source of the Huggable's power" [Canon].
4. Visual language [Observed]:
   - Menu "slides" are 2D comic illustrations on a black grid with green floor lines and a neon-green rim glow (13 files named Photo_27-04-13_*).
   - In-game models are low-poly 3D.
   - Rainbow is the Huggable's blood or power: the Bite Me and Seesaw teeth are smeared with rainbow colours, and the official Huggabundle banner shows rainbow drips.
   - Hit FX seen in 2026 footage: yellow-white star sparks and large white, yellow and orange starburst flashes.
   - Default 3D model (2013 renders and the 2026 trailer/playtest): hot pink; red glossy bead/button eye with a stitched scar running up from it; small black other eye; huge white grin; cream bandage wrapped over the top of the head; green radio box with a silver antenna and red ball tip; diagonal stitched chest scar; torn belly showing grey/metal insides.
   - Team banner on a pole in matches: blue with white swirl/tribal designs in 2026 Steam screens 00 and 04 [Observed].
   - BBR 2011 lineup model: same bandaged, grinning design [Observed: https://i.ytimg.com/vi/0gYEZCMQfmA/hq1.jpg].
5. Era timeline [Fan-wiki unless noted]:
   - BBR launch, Nov 2011: class added per Template "addedgame BBR 1.0". The exact launch kit is Unverified. Headlights is confirmed by Feb 2012 [Game text via wiki]. 2012 BBR menus show Double Rainbow!, Headlights, So Fly, Tough Love, Mini Me, Peek A Boo, Bite Me, Seesaw, Beaver Feaver, Punk Bands and Presidentures [Observed]. Whack-Tus was originally "The Prick".
   - BBR 1.3.1 (28 Jun 2012): Punk Bands, Presidentures, Beaver Fever.
   - BBR 1.4.2 (28 Feb 2013): rebalance; So Fly moved to Gas; Peek A Boo outline added.
   - BBR 1.4.3 (15 Apr 2013): Static Shuffle.
   - BBG 1.0 (24 May 2013).
   - BBG 2.0: So Fly steering.
   - BBG 2.1 (15 Jul 2013): Headlights nerf.
   - BBG 2.2 (21 Aug 2013): Phantom Hug; abilities stop working after death.
   - BBG 2.6 (20 Dec 2013): Losing Your Head and Charged Run; big rebalance; Peek A Boo outline removed.
   - BBG 2.11 (27 Aug 2014): listed only as "Huggable overhaul". Its contents are undocumented [Unverified].
   - BBG 2.20 (29 May 2015): Super Size Me!.
   - BBG 2.21 (3 Jul 2015): Bearettas.
   - 2026 re-release: the Steam trailer shows an So Fly-style flight and a Punk Bands kill; Closed Playtest #4 shows the Pink Huggable with Whack-Tus. The kit appears retained [Inference]. Steam text promises "80+ PRIMARY WEAPONS 60+ SECONDARY WEAPONS 50+ MELEES" [Canon].
   - BBH (2024): Huggy's attack is fast melee ("Slice-n-Bite" per the wiki), with healing per hit [Canon: "boosts his healing with each punch"], and Ultimate So Fly [Canon].
